1.english_reference: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam

traditions.WLC: בִּ שְׁנַ֛ת שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Ἐν τῷ ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας Ἰεροβοὰμ
traditions.VUL: Anno octávo décimo regis Ieróboam ,
traditions.KJV: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam

1.english_reference: began Abijah to reign over Judah

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ה עַל יְהוּדָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐβασίλευσεν Ἀβιὰ ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: regnávit Abía super Iudam .
traditions.KJV: began Abijah to reign over Judah .

2.english_reference: He reigned three years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֗ים מָלַךְ֙ בִּ יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἔτη τρία ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: Tribus annis regnávit in Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: He reigned three years in Jerusalem .

2.english_reference: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ מִיכָיָ֥הוּ בַת אוּרִיאֵ֖ל מִן גִּבְעָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Μααχὰ θυγάτηρ Οὐριὴλ ἀπὸ Γαβαών ·
traditions.VUL: noménque matris eius Michaía fília Uriel de Gábaa :
traditions.KJV: His mother ’s name also [ was ] Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah .

2.english_reference: And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam

traditions.WLC: וּ מִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ה וּ בֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πόλεμος ἦν ἀνὰ μέσον Ἀβιὰ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Ἰεροβοάμ .
traditions.VUL: et erat bellum inter Abíam et Ieróboam .
traditions.KJV: And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam .

3.english_reference: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, [ even ] four hundred thousand chosen men

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּאְסֹ֨ר אֲבִיָּ֜ה אֶת הַ מִּלְחָמָ֗ה בְּ חַ֨יִל֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה אַרְבַּע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֑וּר
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρετάξατο Ἀβιὰ ἐν δυνάμει πολεμισταῖς δυνάμεως τετρακοσίαις χιλιάσιν ἀνδρῶν δυνατῶν ·
traditions.VUL: Cumque iniísset Abía certámen , et habéret bellicosíssimos viros , et electórum quadringénta míllia :
traditions.KJV: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war , [ even ] four hundred thousand chosen men :

3.english_reference: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, [ being ] mighty men of valour

traditions.WLC: וְ יָרָבְעָ֗ם עָרַ֤ךְ עִמּ וֹ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בִּ שְׁמוֹנֶ֨ה מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ בָּח֖וּר גִּבּ֥וֹר חָֽיִל
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰεροβοὰμ παρετάξατο πρὸς αὐτὸν πόλεμον ἐν ὀκτακοσίαις χιλιάσιν , δυνατοὶ πολεμισταὶ δυνάμεως .
traditions.VUL: Ieróboam instrúxit ecóntra áciem octingénta míllia virórum , qui et ipsi elécti erant , et ad bella fortíssimi .
traditions.KJV: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men , [ being ] mighty men of valour .

4.english_reference: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which [ is ] in mount Ephraim

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֣קָם אֲבִיָּ֗ה מֵ עַל֙ לְ הַ֣ר צְמָרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἀβιὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους Σομορών , ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Ἐφράιμ ,
traditions.VUL: Stetit ergo Abía super montem Sémeron , qui erat in Ephraim ,
traditions.KJV: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim , which [ is ] in mount Ephraim ,

4.english_reference: and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֕אמֶר שְׁמָע֖וּ נִי יָרָבְעָ֥ם וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἀκούσατε , Ἰεροβοὰμ καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et ait : Audi Ieróboam , et omnis Israel .
traditions.KJV: and said , Hear me , thou Jeroboam , and all Israel ;

5.english_reference: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹ֤א לָ כֶם֙ לָ דַ֔עַת כִּ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָתַ֨ן מַמְלָכָ֧ה לְ דָוִ֛יד עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: οὐχ ὑμῖν γνῶναι ὅτι Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἔδωκεν βασιλέα ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰσραὴλ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τῷ Δαυεὶδ
traditions.VUL: Num ignorátis quod Dóminus Deus Israel déderit regnum David super Israel in sempitérnum ,
traditions.KJV: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever , [ even ]

5.english_reference: [ even ] to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt

traditions.WLC: ל֥ וֹ וּ לְ בָנָ֖י ו בְּרִ֥ית מֶֽלַח
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ διαθήκῃ ἁλός ;
traditions.VUL: ipsi et fíliis eius in pactum salis ?
traditions.KJV: to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?

6.english_reference: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨קָם֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט עֶ֖בֶד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστη Ἰεροβοὰμ ὁ τοῦ Ναβὰτ ὁ παῖς Σαλωμὼν τοῦ Δαυεὶδ
traditions.VUL: Et surréxit Ieróboam fílius Nabat , servus Salomónis fílii David ,
traditions.KJV: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat , the servant of Solomon the son of David , is risen up ,

6.english_reference: and hath rebelled against his lord

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְרֹ֖ד עַל אֲדֹנָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστη ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et rebellávit contra dóminum suum .
traditions.KJV: and hath rebelled against his lord .

7.english_reference: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקָּבְצ֣וּ עָלָ֗י ו אֲנָשִׁ֤ים רֵקִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י בְלִיַּ֔עַל
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἄνδρες λοιμοὶ υἱοὶ παράνομοι ,
traditions.VUL: Congregatíque sunt ad eum viri vaníssimi , et fílii Bélial :
traditions.KJV: And there are gathered unto him vain men , the children of Belial ,

7.english_reference: and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽתְאַמְּצ֖וּ עַל רְחַבְעָ֣ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστη πρὸς Ῥοβοὰμ τὸν τοῦ Σαλωμών ,
traditions.VUL: et prævaluérunt contra Róboam fílium Salomónis :
traditions.KJV: and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon ,

7.english_reference: when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted

traditions.WLC: וּ רְחַבְעָ֗ם הָ֤יָה נַ֨עַר֙ וְ רַךְ לֵבָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ῥοβοὰμ ἦν νεώτερος καὶ δειλὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: porro Róboam erat rudis , et corde pávido ,
traditions.KJV: when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א הִתְחַזַּ֖ק לִ פְנֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἀντέστη κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: nec pótuit resístere eis .
traditions.KJV: and could not withstand them .

8.english_reference: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֣ה אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֗ים לְ הִתְחַזֵּק֙ לִ פְנֵי֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת יְהוָ֔ה בְּ יַ֖ד בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν λέγετε ὑμεῖς ἀντιστῆναι κατὰ πρόσωπον βασιλείας Κυρίου διὰ χειρὸς υἱῶν Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: Nunc ergo vos dícitis quod resístere possítis regno Dómini , quod póssidet per fílios David ,
traditions.KJV: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David ;

8.english_reference: and ye [ be ] a great multitude

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּם֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑμεῖς πλῆθος πολύ ,
traditions.VUL: habetísque grandem pópuli multitúdinem ,
traditions.KJV: and ye [ be ] a great multitude ,

8.english_reference: and [ there are ] with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods

traditions.WLC: וְ עִמָּ כֶם֙ עֶגְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה לָ כֶ֛ם יָרָבְעָ֖ם לֵ אלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ μεθ᾽ ὑμῶν μόσχοι χρυσοῖ οὓς ἐποίησεν ὑμῖν Ἰεροβοὰμ εἰς θεούς .
traditions.VUL: atque vítulos áureos , quos fecit vobis Ieróboam in deos .
traditions.KJV: and [ there are ] with you golden calves , which Jeroboam made you for gods .

9.english_reference: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites

traditions.WLC: הֲ לֹ֤א הִדַּחְתֶּם֙ אֶת כֹּהֲנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἢ οὐκ ἐξεβάλετε τοὺς ἱερεῖς Κυρίου τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἀαρὼν καὶ τοὺς Λευείτας ,
traditions.VUL: Et eiecístis sacerdótes Dómini , fílios Aaron , atque Levítas ,
traditions.KJV: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites ,

9.english_reference: and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of [ other ] lands

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּעֲשׂ֨וּ לָ כֶ֤ם כֹּהֲנִים֙ כְּ עַמֵּ֣י הָ אֲרָצ֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς ἱερεῖς ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ τῆς γῆς πάσης ;
traditions.VUL: et fecístis vobis sacerdótes sicut omnes pópuli terrárum :
traditions.KJV: and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of [ other ] lands ?

9.english_reference: so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams

traditions.WLC: כָּל הַ בָּ֗א לְ מַלֵּ֨א יָד֜ וֹ בְּ פַ֤ר בֶּן בָּקָר֙ וְ אֵילִ֣ם שִׁבְעָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὁ προσπορευόμενος πληρῶσαι τὰς χεῖρας ἐκ μόσχων ἐκ βοῶν καὶ κριοῖς ἑπτά ,
traditions.VUL: quicúmque vénerit , et initiáverit manum suam in tauro de bobus , et in ariétibus septem ,
traditions.KJV: so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams , [ the same ]

9.english_reference: [ the same ] may be a priest of [ them that are ] no gods

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֥ה כֹהֵ֖ן לְ לֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγίνετο εἰς ἱερέα τῷ μὴ ὄντι θεῷ .
traditions.VUL: fit sacérdos eórum , qui non sunt dii .
traditions.KJV: may be a priest of [ them that are ] no gods .

10.english_reference: But as for us, the LORD [ is ] our God, and we have not forsaken him

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנַ֛חְנוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י נוּ וְ לֹ֣א עֲזַבְנֻ֑ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡμεῖς Κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐνκατελίπομεν ,
traditions.VUL: Noster autem Dóminus , Deus est , quem non relínquimus ,
traditions.KJV: But as for us , the LORD [ is ] our God , and we have not forsaken him ;

10.english_reference: and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, [ are ] the sons of Aaron

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתִ֤ים לַֽ יהוָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτοῦ λειτουργοῦσιν τῷ κυρίῳ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἀαρὼν
traditions.VUL: sacerdotésque minístrant Dómino de fíliis Aaron ,
traditions.KJV: and the priests , which minister unto the LORD , [ are ] the sons of Aaron ,

10.english_reference: and the Levites [ wait ] upon [ their ] business

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֖ם בַּ מְלָֽאכֶת
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἐν ταῖς ἐφημερίαις αὐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: et Levítæ sunt in órdine suo :
traditions.KJV: and the Levites [ wait ] upon [ their ] business :

11.english_reference: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense

traditions.WLC: וּ מַקְטִרִ֣ים לַ יהוָ֡ה עֹל֣וֹת בַּ בֹּֽקֶר בַּ בֹּ֣קֶר וּ בָ עֶֽרֶב בָּ עֶ֣רֶב וּ קְטֹֽרֶת סַמִּים֩
traditions.LXX: θυμιῶσιν τῷ κυρίῳ ὁλοκαύτωμα πρωὶ καὶ δείλης καὶ θυμίαμα συνθέσεως ,
traditions.VUL: holocáusta quoque ófferunt Dómino per síngulos dies mane et véspere , et thymiáma iuxta legis præcépta conféctum ,
traditions.KJV: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense :

11.english_reference: the shewbread also [ set they in order ] upon the pure table

traditions.WLC: וּ מַעֲרֶ֨כֶת לֶ֜חֶם עַל הַ שֻּׁלְחָ֣ן הַ טָּה֗וֹר
traditions.LXX: καὶ προθέσεις ἄρτων ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης τῆς καθαρᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: et proponúntur panes in mensa mundíssima ,
traditions.KJV: the shewbread also [ set they in order ] upon the pure table ;

11.english_reference: and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof , to burn every evening

traditions.WLC: וּ מְנוֹרַ֨ת הַ זָּהָ֤ב וְ נֵרֹתֶ֨י הָ֙ לְ בָעֵר֙ בָּ עֶ֣רֶב בָּ עֶ֔רֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ λυχνία ἡ χρυσῆ καὶ οἱ λυχνοὶ τῆς καύσεως ἀνάψαι δείλης ·
traditions.VUL: estque apud nos candelábrum áureum , et lucérnæ eius , ut accendántur semper ad vésperam :
traditions.KJV: and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof , to burn every evening :

11.english_reference: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שֹׁמְרִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι φυλάσσομεν ἡμεῖς τὰς φυλακὰς Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: nos quippe custodímus præcépta Dómini Dei nostri ,
traditions.KJV: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֖ם עֲזַבְתֶּ֥ם אֹתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐνκατελίπετε αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: quem vos reliquístis .
traditions.KJV: but ye have forsaken him .

12.english_reference: And , behold , God himself [ is ] with us for [ our ] captain

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּה֩ עִמָּ֨ נוּ בָ רֹ֜אשׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֧ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἰδοὺ μεθ᾽ ἡμῶν ἐν ἀρχῇ Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Ergo in exércitu nostro dux Deus est ,
traditions.KJV: And , behold , God himself [ is ] with us for [ our ] captain ,

12.english_reference: and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹהֲנָ֛י ו וַ חֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַ תְּרוּעָ֖ה לְ הָרִ֣יעַ עֲלֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ σάλπιγγες τῆς σημασίας τοῦ σημαίνειν ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς ·
traditions.VUL: et sacerdótes eius , qui clangunt tubis , et résonant contra vos :
traditions.KJV: and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you .

12.english_reference: O children of Israel , fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַל תִּלָּֽחֲמ֛וּ עִם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי אֲבֹתֵי כֶ֖ם
traditions.LXX: οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ , πολεμήσετε πρὸς Κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: fílii Israel nolíte pugnáre contra Dóminum Deum patrum vestrórum ,
traditions.KJV: O children of Israel , fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers ;

traditions.WLC: כִּי לֹ֥א תַצְלִֽיחוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ εὐοδώσεται ὑμῖν .
traditions.VUL: quia non vobis éxpedit .
traditions.KJV: for ye shall not prosper .

13.english_reference: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them

traditions.WLC: וְ יָֽרָבְעָ֗ם הֵסֵב֙ אֶת הַ מַּאְרָ֔ב לָ ב֖וֹא מֵֽ אַחֲרֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰεροβοὰμ ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ ἔνεδρον ἐλθεῖν αὐτῶν ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν ,
traditions.VUL: Hæc illo loquénte , Ieróboam retro moliebátur insídias .
traditions.KJV: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them :

13.english_reference: so they were before Judah , and the ambushment [ was ] behind them

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽהְיוּ֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ הַ מַּאְרָ֖ב מֵ אַחֲרֵי הֶֽם
